# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 3, Playable Rus' Phase 2 (1480-1600) & 6 Cossack Cultures (oe_rp2_). Generated by gen_rus_phase2.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Advance oe_rp2_stage monotonically to $stg$.
oe_rp2_set_stage = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_stage } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_stage value = $stg$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_stage < $stg$ } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_stage value = $stg$ } }
}

# Country scope. Apply bilateral Sophia marriage opinion with live ROM or BYZ.
oe_rp2_apply_sophia_opinion = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Fortify Steppe Abatis Line (tula_russia / voronezh / belgorod, or capital fallback).
oe_rp2_fortify_abatis = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:tula_russia.owner ?= this }
        location:tula_russia = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_abatis_line_loc years = 35 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:voronezh.owner ?= this }
        location:voronezh = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_abatis_line_loc years = 35 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:belgorod.owner ?= this }
        location:belgorod = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_abatis_line_loc years = 35 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { location:tula_russia.owner ?= this }
            NOT = { location:voronezh.owner ?= this }
            NOT = { location:belgorod.owner ?= this }
            exists = capital
        }
        capital = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_abatis_line_loc years = 35 mode = replace } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Settle oe_zaporozhian_cossack frontier soldiers & stanitsa modifier (anchor kichkas, fallback kyiv or capital).
oe_rp2_settle_host_zaporozhian = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered < 6 } change_variable = { name = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered add = 1 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:kichkas.owner ?= this }
        location:kichkas = {
            add_pop = { culture = culture:oe_zaporozhian_cossack religion = root.religion type = pop_type:soldiers size = 0.25 }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_cossack_stanitsa years = 30 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kyiv.owner ?= this }
        location:kyiv = {
            add_pop = { culture = culture:oe_zaporozhian_cossack religion = root.religion type = pop_type:soldiers size = 0.25 }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_cossack_stanitsa years = 30 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = capital }
        capital = {
            add_pop = { culture = culture:oe_zaporozhian_cossack religion = root.religion type = pop_type:soldiers size = 0.25 }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_cossack_stanitsa years = 30 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Bind human Rus' player to Phase 2 without clobbering Phase 1 variables.
oe_rp2_bind_player = {
    save_scope_as = oe_rp2_tmp_player
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_player value = scope:oe_rp2_tmp_player }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_stage } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_stage value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_sophia_state } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sophia_state value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_tsar_crowned } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_tsar_crowned value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_cossack_charter } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_cossack_charter value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_abatis_built } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_abatis_built value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_siberia_push } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_siberia_push value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_phase2_done } } set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_phase2_done value = 0 } }
}

# Any scope. One-time Phase 2 initialization (post-1470).
oe_rp2_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rpl_has_live_player = yes global_var:oe_rpl_player = { is_ai = no } }
        global_var:oe_rpl_player = { oe_rp2_bind_player = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { is_ai = no } }
        c:RUS = { oe_rp2_bind_player = yes }
    }
    else = {
        culture_group:russian_group = {
            random_country_in_culture_group = {
                limit = { oe_rp2_eligible = yes }
                oe_rp2_bind_player = yes
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rp2_has_live_player = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Country scope (tracked human Rus' player). Expire closed windows & fire at most one event per month.
oe_rp2_dispatch_events = {
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1495 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_1 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_1 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1495 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_2 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1495 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_3 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_3 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1530 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_4 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_4 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1568 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_5 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_5 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1585 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_6 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_6 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1555 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_7 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_7 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1555 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_8 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_8 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1575 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_9 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_9 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1590 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_10 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_10 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1602 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_11 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_11 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1605 NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_12 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_fired_12 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_12 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_ev_m ?= global_var:oe_rp2_m } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rp2_open_1 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_ev_m value = global_var:oe_rp2_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rp2_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rp2.1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_rp2_open_2 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_fired_2 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_ev_m value = global_var:oe_rp2_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rp2_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rp2.2
        }
        else_if = {

# Public monthly entry point (called from scheduler slot 48 via oe_rom3_monthly, OR from oe_rp2_pulse.txt).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_rp2_ran_m.
oe_rp2_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_m value = oe_rp2_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1470
            NOT = { global_var:oe_rp2_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_rp2_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_ran_m value = global_var:oe_rp2_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rp2_init } }
            oe_rp2_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                global_var:oe_rp2_end ?= 8
                current_year <= 1605
                oe_rp2_eligible = yes
            }
            oe_rp2_bind_player = yes
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 0 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_on value = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rp2_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1605 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 3 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_rp2_on
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_rp2_has_live_player = yes }
                global_var:oe_rp2_player = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { is_ai = yes }
                        remove_global_variable = oe_rp2_on
                        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 8 }
                    }
                    else = {
                        oe_rp2_dispatch_events = yes
                    }
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { is_ai = no } }
                c:RUS = {
                    oe_rp2_bind_player = yes
                    oe_rp2_dispatch_events = yes
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 8 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_rp2_on
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_rp2_job_11 = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sophia_state value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sophia_done value = 1 }
        add_prestige = 15
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_sophia_grand_alliance years = 25 mode = replace }

# Country scope. Cycle through the 6 Cossack frontier hosts for oe_rp2_dec_charter_cossack_host.
oe_rp2_charter_next_host = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered } } oe_rp2_settle_host_zaporozhian = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered = 0 } oe_rp2_settle_host_zaporozhian = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered = 1 } oe_rp2_settle_host_don = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered = 2 } oe_rp2_settle_host_yaik = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered = 3 } oe_rp2_settle_host_terek = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered = 4 } oe_rp2_settle_host_siberian = yes }
    else = { oe_rp2_settle_host_kuban = yes }
}

oe_rp2_test_start = {
    oe_rp2_test_clear = yes
    oe_rp2_bind_player = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rp2_m value = oe_rp2_m_now }
}

oe_rp2_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_rp2_ran_m
    oe_rp2_monthly = yes
}

oe_rp2_test_me_1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rp2_on } } oe_rp2_test_start = yes }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rp2.1
}
